# Lisbon 5-Day Trip Plan: 2 Adults, 10–14 Sep 2025

A comfortable, low-walking Lisbon itinerary with one museum maximum per day, vegetarian-friendly meals, and one built-in rest evening. Estimated on-trip spend is kept within **€1,400 total** excluding flights.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary

### Day 1: Baixa + Chiado Arrival Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and keep the first day light with a slow walk through **Baixa** and **Rossio**.
- Afternoon: Ride the **Santa Justa area** and browse **Rua Augusta**; short stops only, no museum today.
- Evening: Easy vegetarian dinner in **Chiado**; early night to reset.
- Food: Grilled vegetable plates, sopa, salads, and vegetarian petiscos.

### Day 2: Alfama + Tram Views
- Morning: Start at **Miradouro de Santa Luzia** and **Portas do Sol** for scenic views with minimal exertion.
- Afternoon: Explore **Alfama** slowly by tram and short uphill segments; optional stop at **Lisbon Cathedral**.
- Evening: Fado-style neighborhood dinner or a relaxed riverside walk.
- Food: Vegetarian bifana-style sandwiches, soups, and baked cod-free local plates.

### Day 3: Belém Heritage Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit **Jerónimos Monastery** or **MAAT**; choose just one museum/monument visit.
- Afternoon: Walk the flat riverside stretch to **Belém Tower** and **Monument to the Discoveries**.
- Evening: Free time for rest, laundry, reading, or a quiet café.
- Food: Vegetarian pastéis alternatives, salads, soups, and grain bowls.

### Day 4: Parque das Nações + Oceanfront Leisure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Ride to **Parque das Nações** for an easy, modern waterfront stroll.
- Afternoon: Optional **Oceanário de Lisboa** if you want a single museum-style visit; otherwise keep it open.
- Evening: Relaxed dinner and a low-key promenade by the river.
- Food: Vegetarian rice bowls, Mediterranean plates, and café-style lunches.

### Day 5: Príncipe Real + Final Shopping
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Browse **Príncipe Real** gardens, design shops, and calm streets.
- Afternoon: Light shopping in **Avenida da Liberdade** and coffee stop in **Santos** or **Chiado**.
- Evening: Farewell dinner with a reservation in a vegetarian-friendly restaurant.
- Food: Seasonal vegetable dishes, tapas-style plates, and dessert pastries.

## Timeline Chart and Budget Plan

### 5-Day Timeline
Day 1 | Arrival + Baixa/Chiado | Easy walking | Dinner out | Rest early
Day 2 | Alfama views + tram | Scenic stops | Neighborhood dinner | Light evening
Day 3 | Belém heritage | One museum/monument | Riverside walk | **Free evening**
Day 4 | Parque das Nações | Waterfront leisure | Optional Oceanário | Relaxed night
Day 5 | Príncipe Real + shopping | Slow city stroll | Farewell meal | Pack and depart

### Estimated Daily Costs
Day 1 | Lodging €120 | Food €55 | Transit €15 | Activities €20 | Total **€210**
Day 2 | Lodging €120 | Food €60 | Transit €18 | Activities €25 | Total **€223**
Day 3 | Lodging €120 | Food €60 | Transit €22 | Activities €40 | Total **€242**
Day 4 | Lodging €120 | Food €60 | Transit €20 | Activities €35 | Total **€235**
Day 5 | Lodging €120 | Food €65 | Transit €15 | Activities €25 | Total **€225**

### Budget Check
- Lodging: **€600**
- Food: **€300**
- Local transport: **€90**
- Activities/entry: **€145**
- Coffee/snacks/contingency: **€165**
- Total estimated spend: **€1,300**

## Neighborhoods to Stay In

| Neighborhood | Best For | Walking Level | Transit Access | Fit for This Trip |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Baixa | Central base, easy sightseeing | Low | Excellent | Best all-around choice |
| Chiado | Cafés, dining, upscale feel | Low to moderate | Excellent | Great for evenings and food |
| Príncipe Real | Calm, stylish, residential | Moderate | Good | Best for a quieter stay |
| Avenida da Liberdade | Comfortable hotels, central access | Low | Excellent | Strong for comfort and convenience |
| Santos | Riverside feel, dining, design spots | Moderate | Good | Good value if you like a local vibe |
